description: OMNIGATE Runtime catalog search (FREE). Finds SML paid routes a runtime script can call with sml.call(id, {query|path|body}), with live per-call USDC prices, plus published capsules (ready-made scripts). Use this before omnigate_runtime_execute to pick route ids. Prices are the live upstream registry amounts; nothing here spends.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "short squeeze", "sec filings", "web extract". Empty lists everything (capped).

name: omnigate_runtime_search
